expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no button'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'marketplace=' + t.includes('Plugin marketplace') + ' | availableZone=' + t.includes('AVAILABLE IN THE CATALOG') + ' | helloCard=' + t.includes('Hello Catalog') + ' | installBtn=' + Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).some(b => /install/i.test(b.textContent || '')) + ' | installedGrid=' + t.includes('Hello World'); })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /^install$/i.test((x.textContent || '').trim())); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked Install'; } return 'no install btn'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'installedZone=' + t.includes('INSTALLED FROM THE MARKETPLACE') + ' | uninstallBtn=' + Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).some(b => /uninstall/i.test(b.textContent || '')) + ' | stillAvailable=' + t.includes('AVAILABLE IN THE CATALOG'); })()
(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /uninstall/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked Uninstall'; } return 'no uninstall btn'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'backToAvailable=' + t.includes('AVAILABLE IN THE CATALOG') + ' | helloCard=' + t.includes('Hello Catalog') + ' | installedZoneGone=' + !t.includes('INSTALLED FROM THE MARKETPLACE'); })()
